subject: english
stem: A community speaker gives this announcement. Which action is planned or required in the full message?
options: send a photo of every item in the striped umbrella
describe another item in the striped umbrella at the school office
describe the bus map only when claiming the striped umbrella
claim the striped umbrella at the school office

describe another item in the striped umbrella at the school office：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「describe another item in the striped umbrella at the school office」。

claim the striped umbrella at the school office：此項把「describe another item in」改成「claim」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「describe another item in the striped umbrella at the school office」。因此，鎖定證據支持「describe another item in the striped umbrella at the school office」。
